idea-plugin.name: async-test Detector
idea-plugin.description:
Surfaces concurrency issues detected by the async-test library directly inside IntelliJ IDEA.

After your test suite runs with JsonReportListener registered, click View → Tool Windows → async-test Findings (or press the toolbar button) to see all detector findings grouped by severity — without switching to the terminal or grepping log files.

Features

  • Reads async-test-report.json from Maven or Gradle build output
  • Colour-coded severity: CRITICAL (red), HIGH (orange), MEDIUM (yellow), LOW (green)
  • Expandable finding details with the full detector report
  • One-click refresh after re-running tests
  • Configurable report file path in Settings → Tools → async-test

Setup

Register JsonReportListener in your test class:

@BeforeAll
static void setup() {
    AsyncTestListenerRegistry.register(new JsonReportListener());
}
